Earlier today, a Lebanese Army vehicle drove over an explosive device in southern Lebanon. As a result, a Lebanese Army soldier was killed, and two additional soldiers were injured. Following a review, it can be determined that the explosive device did not belong to the IDF and was most likely placed in the area by the Hezbollah terrorist organization. The incident occurred in the area of Al-Mansouri, within the Security Zone in southern Lebanon. In this area, IDF soldiers have not been present recently. It should be noted that the Lebanese Army vehicle entered the Security Zone without prior coordination with the IDF, as required according to the existing coordination mechanism. The IDF calls on the Lebanese civilians and the forces present in the area to avoid entering areas where Hezbollah continues to pose a threat and to coordinate movements in advance, as required, for their safety.

The Ministry of Interior, in cooperation with China’s Ministry of Public Security and the People’s Public Security University of China, organized the joint "Tamkeen" training program in Beijing, with the participation of 24 personnel from the Ministry and Dubai Police. The initiative reflects the strength of the strategic partnership between the UAE and China in the security field. The program included specialized lectures, workshops, and field visits focusing on the application of artificial intelligence in policing, data analysis, decision-support systems, cybercrime prevention, digital investigations, and economic crimes linked to digital assets and cryptocurrencies, in addition to showcasing the latest technologies in smart cities and advanced security systems. During official meetings held on the sidelines of the program, both sides discussed ways to enhance future cooperation in training, innovation, and security capacity-building, contributing to strengthening the readiness of law enforcement agencies to address future security challenges. #وزارة_الداخلية_الإمارات #فخورين_بالإمارات 🇦🇪 #الامارات_أمن_وأمان #MOIUAE
